bet: BET 10 — Say only what is true (claim/reality reconciliation)
auditBasis: Every public sentence maps to a live query or test that passes, or to a copy change that brings the sentence back in line with the data. Claims that depend on a Nish-reserved decision are flagged without being resolved.

resultLegend.pass: the mapped query/test runs and confirms the claim against live code or live data
resultLegend.fail_copy_change_needed: the mapped query/test runs and the live data does not support the claim as written; the copy must change
resultLegend.pass_code_data_pending: the code-level test passes, but the live-data query is pending a populated table and is tracked separately
resultLegend.nish_reserved: the claim depends on a decision only Nish can make (e.g. funnel-measurement); flagged, not resolved

claims.text: Five to Nine watches competitors' landing pages for price, offer, and CTA changes, then sends screenshot evidence and change alerts before your next meeting. ... saves the screenshots, and files the brief.
claims.surface: homepage meta description, homepage hero deck, competitor-monitoring meta description, competitor-monitoring hero deck, pricing evidence-usage copy, compare/magicbrief migration FAQ
claims.liveQueryOrTest: Live D1 query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM proof_capture WHERE screenshot_artifact_key IS NOT NULL AND status='succeeded'; vs total succeeded proof_capture rows. Code test: tests/proof-screenshot.server.test.ts (key shape validation), tests/monitoring-landing-page-snapshot.test.ts (snapshot+artifact persistence on capture).
claims.resultDetail: category-research.md §1.5b: 115/598 proof_capture carry screenshot_artifact_key (19%). The code path persists screenshotArtifactKey on a successful browser-render capture (monitoring-landing-page-snapshot.test.ts proves the path), but the live data shows only ~19% of succeeded captures actually carry a screenshot key. The public sentence 'saves the screenshots' outruns the data: it implies every confirmed change gets a screenshot, while 81% do not. Copy change needed: scope 'saves the screenshots' to 'saves the screenshot when the page renders' or 'saves page text and the source link, and a screenshot when the page renders', so the claim matches the 19% reality until capture coverage closes.
claims.betOrCopyChange: copy change needed — scope the screenshot claim to render-dependent until screenshot_artifact_key coverage reaches 100% of succeeded proof_capture rows
